## Highlights

- **TF-IDF weighting, as a script** (#207). `assets/scripts/tfidf.py INPUT_DIR OUTPUT_DIR` reads `op-seq`, `op-freq`, `fc-seq`, `fc-freq`, `op-{k}gram-seq` or `op-{k}gram-freq` birthmarks and writes each as the matching frequency birthmark, its counts weighted by how rare each element is among the functions of all the inputs, so that an element nearly every function has counts for little. The outputs are ordinary frequency birthmarks: `compare` reads them under every frequency algorithm, and only birthmarks converted together are comparable with each other. The IDF table they came from is written to `OUTPUT_DIR/idf.csv`.

Nothing in oinkie itself changes: no code, no options, no scores.
